ShortDescription.Value: Auto clean deathcare, or tune it with Funeral Director; Bonus Status report.

Publish.LongDescription:
## Magic Hearse + New Funeral Director
Two modes:
### Option 1: Auto Clean (magic)
- Removes dead citizens automatically when they are waiting for a hearse. - Great for death-waves and notification spam. Lightweight design for best city performance.
### Option 2: Funeral Director (self manage)
Tune deathcare values: - Processing rate (crematoriums) - Fleet size (max hearses per facility) - Cemetery storage multiplier
- **Max Workers** tuning (place a new building or add/remove an extension refreshes values). - Compatibility Toggle ✅ turn OFF workers if you prefer to use ConfigXML mod for worker numbers.
## NEW Bonus Status Report - All major deathcare stats: how many dead are waiting for hearses and more! - Scan runs/updates only in the Options menu or when a slider is used (lightweight, no city per-frame impact).
## Features - Toggle on/off without restarting the game. - Safe to remove any time. Uncheck both checkboxes turns off the mod. - Disable other hearse mods to avoid conflicts! - No Harmony or reflection (more reliable on patch days). - Use either Auto clean or Self manage (mutually exclusive). - 11 languages
## Support and Feedback - If the mod works for you, give it a Like! - Feedback: GitHub / Forums / Discord.
## Credits - River-Mochi: author - Thanks to Wayz, creator of the original Magical Hearse - Necko1996: testing, screenshots - yenyang: technical consultant
## How it works - If the citizen is flagged as dead and needs transport, it's cleaned up. Looks like magic but the secret is flags. - Mod does not stop death - it's just very fast corpse cleanup. - Status scan is essentially no performance impact :) since it only runs in the Options menu, not in the city. - Mod can be safely removed. Buildings retain new worker numbers until rebuilt; all new buildings will have standard worker numbers. - set all sliders to 100% and uncheck Funeral Director for faster reset, but it's not required.
Publish.ChangeLog: * Added Max Workers control. * Added Compatibility toggle (works with other worker tuning mods) * Added Status report for major deathcare stats. * Updated all Locale files for new features.
